title: Integral pullback of a flat open geometrically integral morphism
statement: Let $X,Y,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with morphisms $f:X\to S$ and $g:Y\to S$. Suppose $f$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and universally open, meaning that every base change of $f$ is open on underlying topological spaces. Suppose $f$ is geometrically integral: for every field $K$ and every morphism $\operatorname{Spec}K\to S$, the scheme $X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}K$ is integral [def-pc-integral-scheme]. If $Y$ is integral and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], then the ordinary fibre product $X\times_SY$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is integral.
